assertions.title: Node can be added to the workflow

steps.action: Launch browser at http://localhost:5173, wait 15s for R process
steps.expected: Workspace renders with no error banners
steps.observed: Workspace rendered successfully with 2 existing source nodes (node_9648bcd9, node_f8e70420). Session status showed 'ready'.

steps.action: Click on REPL terminal textbox, wait 1s, type 'bayesgrove::bg_add_node(project, kind = "source")' and press Enter
steps.expected: Command is sent to R and succeeds
steps.observed: Command typed and sent via keyboard inserttext + Enter. Node count increased from 2 to 3 after ~5 seconds, with new node_c470c1dc appearing.

evidence.network: REPL command sent via xterm.js keyboard input; WebSocket repl.write RPC inferred from node appearing in graph

assertions.title: Nodes appear on graph canvas after being added

steps.action: After adding node via REPL, check canvas for .react-flow__node elements
Check toolbar summary and explorer panel for updated node count
steps.expected: Explorer shows incremented count and new node listed
steps.observed: Explorer 'Data Sources' button changed from 'Data Sources 2' to 'Data Sources 3'. New node_c470c1dc listed under Data Sources group.

evidence.network: Graph snapshot update received via WebSocket workflow.snapshot push

assertions.title: Node detail drawer opens on node click

steps.expected: Node detail drawer opens showing node information
steps.observed: Detail drawer opened with full node info: label 'node_c470c1dc', kind 'source', status 'state ok', obligations 0, summaries 0, decisions 0, notes field, and 'Return to canvas' button.

evidence.network: No additional network requests needed; drawer is a client-side view transition

assertions.title: Node can be deleted from the workflow

steps.action: Click 'Return to canvas' to close detail drawer
steps.expected: Canvas view restored with nodes visible
steps.observed: Clicking 'Return to canvas' button did not dismiss the drawer. The drawer remained open. Tried Escape key, clicking '🕸️ Workflow DAG' button, navigating to /settings and back — drawer persisted or canvas showed 'Waiting for the first graph snapshot from bayesgrove…' overlay after navigation.

steps.action: After page reload, attempt to add a new node for delete test
steps.expected: New node added and visible on canvas
steps.observed: After reload, canvas showed 'Waiting for the first graph snapshot from bayesgrove…' overlay. REPL command typed but node did not appear (graph snapshot not received). Backend health check (curl localhost:3100/health) returned connection refused — server crashed.
curl exit code 7 (connection refused). Backend server on port 3100 is no longer running.

evidence.network: Backend server at localhost:3100 became unreachable (connection refused)

assertions.issues: Backend server crashed during test. Unable to complete node deletion test. The 'Return to canvas' button in the node detail drawer did not work reliably — clicking it did not dismiss the drawer view, requiring navigation to /settings and back, after which the canvas showed a 'Waiting for graph snapshot' overlay that never resolved because the server had crashed.

frictions.description: The 'Return to canvas' button in the NodeDetailDrawer does not reliably close the drawer. Clicking it multiple times, pressing Escape, and clicking the '🕸️ Workflow DAG' tab all failed to return to the canvas view. Only navigating away (to /settings) and back restored the canvas, but then the graph snapshot was not received.
frictions.resolution: Workaround was to navigate to /settings and back to /, but this caused the WebSocket to reconnect and the graph snapshot to be lost (server crash).

frictions.description: After navigating away from the workspace (/) to /settings and back, the canvas showed 'Waiting for the first graph snapshot from bayesgrove…' overlay indefinitely, even though the REPL showed 'interactive ready'. The server subsequently crashed.
frictions.resolution: Could not resolve — the backend server (port 3100) stopped responding to health checks.

blockers.description: Backend server (port 3100) crashed during testing. curl localhost:3100/health returns connection refused. Vite dev server (port 5173) still serves the SPA but the workspace cannot function without the backend. This prevented completing VAL-GUI-012 (node deletion test).
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Reloaded page, waited 15 seconds, verified with curl — server confirmed down.

summary: Tested 4 assertions: 3 passed (VAL-GUI-008, VAL-GUI-009, VAL-GUI-011), 1 blocked (VAL-GUI-012). Node addition via REPL works correctly, nodes appear on canvas and in explorer with updated counts, and the node detail drawer opens on click showing comprehensive node info. VAL-GUI-012 was blocked because the backend server crashed during testing, and the 'Return to canvas' button in the detail drawer did not work reliably (friction noted).
